tool.name: repertoire_profiler
tool.description: Ig/TR repertoire annotation, clonal groups, alignments and trees
tool.command:
#set $repo = $__tool_directory__ + '/..' ## nextflow.config uses ./bin/... paths (relative to the launch folder, which is the job folder here) ln -s '$repo/bin' bin && ln -s '$fasta_zip' sample.zip && #if $metadata: ln -s '$metadata' metadata.tsv && #end if
python3 '$repo/galaxy/fill_config.py' --template '$repo/nextflow.config' --locked '$repo/galaxy/locked_params.txt' #if $params: --values '$params' #end if --set "sample_path=\$PWD/sample.zip" #if $metadata: --set "meta_path=\$PWD/metadata.tsv" #else: --set meta_path=NULL #end if --set system_exec=local --set "apptainer_local_images=\${RP_APPTAINER_CACHE:?RP_APPTAINER_CACHE must be set by the Galaxy admins}" --set "cluster_runOptions=\${RP_APPTAINER_OPTIONS:---no-home --bind /pasteur} --env XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp" --set "phylo_tree_model_path=$repo/bin/AB_model" --set phylo_tree_itol_subscription=FALSE --set "out_path_ini=\$PWD/results" --set result_folder_name=repertoire_profiler -o job.config && printf '\nprocess.resourceLimits = [cpus: %s, memory: "%s MB"]\n' "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" "\${GALAXY_MEMORY_MB:-16000}" >> job.config &&
export NXF_HOME="\$PWD/.nextflow_home" && export NXF_OFFLINE=true && nextflow -C job.config run '$repo/main.nf' -work-dir work -ansi-log false &&
cd results/repertoire_profiler_* && zip -q -r '$results' . && cp report.html '$report'

param.name: fasta_zip
param.label: Zip of the fasta files
param.help: sample_path parameter: a .zip file that contains only fasta files (one or several sequences per file).

param.name: metadata
param.label: Metadata file (optional)
param.help: meta_path parameter: .tsv file with a column of sequence names (see meta_seq_names).

param.name: params
param.label: Parameters (optional)
param.help: JSON object {parameter: value} of the nextflow.config parameters to change, as written by the repertoire_profiler web page. Parameters not given keep their nextflow.config default.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Runs the repertoire_profiler Nextflow pipeline (https://github.com/gael-millot/repertoire_profiler) on Ig or TR sequences: V(D)J annotation with IgBlast, productive sequence selection, clonal groups, mutation load, repertoires, alignments, phylogenetic trees and an HTML report.
**Inputs**
- a .zip of fasta files (the sample_path parameter of nextflow.config) - an optional metadata .tsv file (meta_path) - an optional JSON file of parameters. All the parameters of the "Parameters that must be set by the user" section of nextflow.config can be set, except the execution ones listed in galaxy/locked_params.txt.
**Outputs**
- a .zip of the whole result folder (see the Output section of the README) - the HTML report
